result.quote: And after the man of God had finished eating and drinking, the old prophet who had brought him back saddled the donkey for him.
result.reason: The verse says the man of God—not the old prophet—finished eating and drinking. It then says the old prophet saddled the donkey for him. Thus the intended action is evident, but “after eating” grammatically suggests that the old prophet ate, and “the man’s donkey” asserts ownership not explicitly stated. Revise to: “What did the old prophet do after the man of God finished eating and drinking?” Key: “He saddled the donkey for him.”
